packageRules.description: Majors that stop Renovate from regenerating yarn.lock, or that @backstage/* pins through its own ranges. Renovate still opens the PR when `yarn install` fails, but with a stale yarn.lock, so the image build dies on `yarn install --immutable` (#39: typescript 7 breaks yarn 4.13's builtin compat patch; react 19, react-router 7/8, jsdom 30 and better-sqlite3 13 contradict @backstage/*'s ranges). These move when the @backstage/* packages move.
Backstage ships ~100 packages in lockstep, and a per-package fan-out over a yarn.lock this size is exactly the shape that has OOMKilled the Renovate job before. One grouped MR instead.
Everything else npm, also grouped, for the same reason.
